programs.title: Motown Magic
programs.sub_title: I Cant Help Myself Sugar Pie Honey Bunch And Don't You Worry Bout A Thing
programs.desc: Imaginative boy Ben transforms his city by bringing colourful street art to life, armed with a magic paintbrush and the classic sounds of Motown.

programs.title: The Magic Canoe
programs.desc: Pam doesn't say what she really wants and accumulates frustrations. When she meets the chicoque (skunk in the Cree and Metis language), she realizes that it would be better to say what bothers her.

programs.title: Spartakus And The Sun Beneath The Sea
programs.desc: A giant chessboard on which you play your life against creatures from all strata: here is the challenge that the pirates must meet.

programs.title: The World According To Grandpa
programs.desc: Louie asks who invented dogs and Grandpa spins a tall tales about a young girl called Megan who discovered a teapot genie in the attic of her new house.

programs.title: Chums
programs.desc: The Chums meet a a young bear with very ticklish feet. Using the forest and their imagination, they try to help their new chum.

programs.title: Tales From Zambia
programs.desc: Along the bank of the Luangwa River in Zambia lives a large troop of baboons. Despite the difficulties of the dry season, baby baboons are born. This is the story of a young male baboon who faces difficult choices as he comes of age.
